5. Benefit Assessment
mRNA-1273 continues to demonstrate robust protection against COVID-19, including severe disease, hospitalization, and death. Effectiveness data from real-world evidence studies across multiple countries confirms the favorable benefit profile observed in pre-authorization clinical trials.
6. Benefit-Risk Conclusion
The overall benefit-risk balance for mRNA-1273 (Spikevax) remains favorable. The benefits of vaccination in preventing COVID-19 and its serious complications continue to outweigh the identified and potential risks. No new safety signals requiring urgent regulatory action were identified during this reporting period.
